EmailTemplate.description: Sent to a channel partner when the termination of its access is approved (Partner Portal Setting: Termination Email Template).
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Access Terminated
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties channel partner access
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
The channel partner access of {!Account.Name} to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal has been terminated.
QUESTIONS? If you have any questions, please contact the JKP CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
